name: Viridien Société anonyme
summary: Viridien Société anonyme provides earth science, data science, sensing, and monitoring data, products, services, and solutions in North America, Latin America, the Central and South Americas, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through two segments, Data, Digital & Energy Transition (DDE); and Sensing & Monitoring (SMO).
